---
title: "Test"
output: html_document
date: "2026-06-21"
---


This experimental Rmd file takes the results of BMD analysis utilizing bootstrapping as input and aims to use that input to perform response-response modeling. Since concentrations between subsequent assays may not be well aligned. Dual responses from both assays at the same concentration might be scarce, we therefore supplement these scarce datasets of subsequent responses with artificial data gathered from fitted bootstrap curves. 

Status: matching the data of subsequent KEs is successful, the fitting of response-response curves through these matched datasets using orthogonal distance regression is not yet successful.

##Loading packages
```{r,warning=F, message=F}
library(minpack.lm)
library(ggplot2)
library(reshape2)
library(dplyr)
library(patchwork)
library(purrr)
library(tidyr)
library(stringr)
source('Functions_BMD.R')
source('Functions_RR.R')
```


##Reading in data
```{r}
EMS_wpinput = readRDS('../processedData/EMS_wpinput.rds')
MMS_wpinput = readRDS('../processedData/MMS_wpinput.rds')
ENU_wpinput = readRDS('../processedData/ENU_wpinput.rds')

EMS_subsets = readRDS('../processedData/EMS_subsets.rds')
MMS_subsets = readRDS('../processedData/MMS_subsets.rds')
ENU_subsets = readRDS('../processedData/ENU_subsets.rds')
```

```{r}
alkyl_SIO = EMS_subsets$alkyl$data[[which(EMS_subsets$alkyl$subset_name == 'SIO')]]
comet_hAAG_SIM = EMS_subsets$`Comet hAAG modified`$data[[which(EMS_subsets$`Comet hAAG modified`$subset_name == 'SIM')]]
comet_SIM = EMS_subsets$`Comet Unmodified`$data[[which(EMS_subsets$`Comet Unmodified`$subset_name == 'SIM')]]
gh2ax_SIF = EMS_subsets$gh2ax$data[[which(EMS_subsets$gh2ax == 'SIF')]]
MN_SEMC = EMS_subsets$MN$data[[which(EMS_subsets$MN == 'SEMC')]]
muta_SEOH = EMS_subsets$muta$data[[which(EMS_subsets$muta == 'SEOH')]]

muta_SEOT = EMS_subsets$muta$data[[which(EMS_subsets$muta == 'SEOT')]]
```




##Actual analysis


alkyl_SIO vs MN_SEMC
```{r,warning=F}
fit_response_response(df1 = alkyl_SIO,
                      df2 = MN_SEMC,
                      wpinput1 = EMS_wpinput$alkyl_SIO,
                      wpinput2 = EMS_wpinput$MN_SEMC,
                      main = 'DNA adducts vs MN assay',
                      xlab = 'DPM',
                      ylab = '% of MN cells (FC)', 
                      savepath = '../Figures/Response-Response/Fig5/',
                      zoom = 3)
```

fit_response_response(df1 = comet_hAAG_SIM,
